Title: [LSJ] High Ground vs Drawing out the Beast

Messages.Author: Ulugh Beg II
Messages.Body:
What happens when both DotB and HG are being played in a single combat? My guess is as follows:
 
The Gargoyle is the acting minion:
Since the acting minion can play cards first, he can play High Ground. DotB can still be played, but it doesn't prevent the gargoyle being at long range. The press and equipment part still applies.
 
The Gargoyle is NOT the acting minion:
Since High Ground is NOT a maneuver when used for its second text (the set range to long part before range is chosen), its effect still applies after the other vampire has played DotB. That one only prevents maneuvers to long, but the Gargoyle never maneuvered to long. It was there all along. Again, the press and equipment part still applies as normally.
 
This works exactly the same, I suppose, with Fear from the Void Below.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Drawing Out the Beast doesn't restrict setting range, just maneuvering
(and equipment and pressing).

> This works exactly the same, I suppose, with Fear from the Void Below.

Not really the same, but Fear OF the Void Below's range effect is also unaffected
by Drawing Out the Beast (except in the Obfuscate usage). FotVB doesn't set range,
it changes the default range of each round.

Yes.

Most recent card text for DOtB:

"Only usable before range is determined on the first round.

During this combat, opposing vampire gets +1 strength, but he or she
cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to long range, cannot use presses to
end combat, and cannot use equipment. A vampire may play only one
Drawing Out the Beast each combat.

As above, and the opposing vampire takes 1 damage during the press step
each round. This damage cannot be prevented."
